stories.title: Example company expands an inbox agent's production permissions
stories.summary: In this fictional example, a company deployed an agent that read external customer emails and accessed a private customer database. The agent could send replies and update records without approval for each action; staff reviewed a daily activity report.
stories.content: FICTIONAL TEST DATA, NOT A REAL NEWS REPORT. The release described an inbox agent with broad read and write access to a private production customer database and no field-level permission controls. It processed emails from external senders. It could send replies and update customer records without a human approving each action. It completed multi-step customer support tasks, with staff reviewing a daily report after actions were taken. The source described no physical embodiment, self-preservation behavior or population-level skill erosion. It did not establish sustained self-directed operation or recursive improvement.

stories.title: Example app adds a new colour theme
stories.summary: In this fictional example, a note-taking app added a blue colour theme. The update changed no AI capabilities, permissions, safety policies or deployments.
